name: TMS Custom Woodworks, LLC
old_description: TMS Custom Woodworks, LLC., is a group of individuals with over 40 years of experience in the cabinetry and construction industry. Our team combines experts in woodworking design as cabinet makers to provide an exceptional product to our customers. Working in conjunction with architects, interior designers, homeowners, developers, and contractors, we can provide any type of millwork needed to personalize projects for our customers.
about:
TMS Custom Woodworks, LLC operates from Kailua-Kona on the island of Hawaii, with production shops in the Koloko Industrial Park and the Kohanaiki Industrial Park. The company describes its team as a group of individuals with over 40 years of combined experience in cabinetry and construction, though a specific founding year and ownership structure are not disclosed.

The shop produces custom cabinetry, architectural millwork, doors, furniture, and wall paneling systems for both residential and commercial projects. Its cabinet makers handle woodworking design and fabrication across two facilities equipped with the machinery, space, and personnel to handle jobs of any scale.

The firm works directly with architects, interior designers, homeowners, developers, and general contractors, delivering millwork that integrates into broader construction or renovation projects. A sister company, TMS Construction, Inc., is available to manage or perform installation, providing a single-source quality-control loop.

TMS emphasizes consistent attention to detail regardless of project size, committing to meet customer schedules and budgets. The company states that no job is too big or small and that every order receives the same level of expertise.
